description: Pages AI answers cite, by brand, topic, market, question, engine, site or facet. For outreach pass pages = third_party: most cited pages are brands' own sites, and this leaves them out. Each row: citations, answers and questions citing it (over the whole filter), weeks cited, answersCiting, answersNaming and answersOmitting (over every answer citing it, the brand rule aside: not the same answers as the first counts), page type (the judge's) and kind (the one to read), owner, brands listed, and whether it lists the brand (listsBrand, with listsBrandBy: the page judge, or the name absent from the stored page), and retrievedBy: how many search surfaces returned it for those questions. brandRule: "not_named" lists gap pages. Reading here records the ask for the page judge when a page was never judged or names a brand it has not judged. With credits $0.005 a call (later pages free); without, samples and aggregates (own brands in full).

explain.description: add one plain sentence saying what the reply shows

fields.description: columns to keep in each row

filter.description: which answers count; window is a separate argument, not part of filter

brand.description: brd_ ids; with brandRule, which answers count

brandRule.description: default named; warned: the answer advises against the brand by the caution-insight rule (warnsAgainst: the judge's advised_against at least 0.65 and the brand not only a cited source; list_facets: mention.advised_against). It misses most warnings (recall 0.34) and is NOT the app's Answers page rule, which reads the judged treatment warned_against (list_facets: mention.treatment)

country.description: ISO country codes the question was asked from; an answer asked with no place set counts as US

engine.description: surface ids (list_facets: engine); without engine or surfaceClass, the counted engines

place.description: plc_ ids (resolve_ids finds them): the place a question is about, with the places under each (a region holds its cities). "all": every place, in place of a local subject's area. A country code here reads as filter.country for one release

scope.description: default all: public plus this workspace's own; own: only the answers this workspace bought; tracked: its own answers and those about the questions, topics and brands it watches with the track tool (not the brands it added in the app); public: public answers only

site.description: domains or site: ids of cited sites

surfaceClass.description: classes of engines to cover; default counted

text.description: Full-text search over answer text: keywords, "exact phrases", AND/OR/NOT, NEAR/n, prefix*. A call reads at most the first 100,000 matches (20,000 in search_answers) before the brand filter and the rest apply: a brand filter does not narrow it, so a common word over a long window can miss a brand's answers; narrow by window, topic, market or engine

level.description: how brands count: company (default; a company and its products are one brand) or product (each brand on its own, so a product's numbers leave out its siblings)

listsBrand.description: needs filter.brand: true keeps pages the page judge says list the brand, false pages it says do not (a page it never judged for the brand is in neither). With brandRule not_named, false is the pages to pitch and true the pages that list you while answers omit you

minRetrievedBy.description: only pages at least this many search surfaces returned (retrievedBy.surfaces)

pages.description: all, or third_party: only pages on no brand's own site (not the filter brand's, not any other brand's): the pages to pitch. Write the value bare, with no quotes inside the string. Default all

window.description: Time window; default the last 28 days. "last" or from/to.

name: search_cited_pages
title: Search pages AI answers cite
